thread:
Olivia (eng-releases): Quick heads-up — we need coordinated version bumps across API, runtime, console, and SDKs before Tuesday cutoff (2026-04-07 17:00 PT). Can each repo confirm owner and PR target branch? I'm aiming to do a single coordinated release window to avoid mismatch in semver.

Sam K: I'll take API. PR will target release/v0.14. I'll open it today. ETA for review: ~3h.

Maria L: Runtime here — I'm finalizing kernel selection flags. Will push bump PR to main->release/v0.14 by EOD. Changelog: any specific phrasing for perf improvements?

Raj P: SDKs + console. SDKs need a minor API change pinned in client: we'll bump to 0.14.2. Console has CSS and telemetry tweaks, target branch release/v0.14-console. cc @Olivia (eng-releases) for rollouts.

Olivia (eng-releases): For changelog phrasing, keep short: "improve inference kernel selection; perf improvements and bug fixes." I'll consolidate entries.

Sam K: Example commit we use:

``
chore(api): bump to 0.14.0
BREAKING: none
```

Also opening PR: https://git.internal/redwood/api/pull/4321

ci-bot: ci-bot: All builds passing for api PR 4321 — tests: unit, integration. :white_check_mark: 

Maria L: Note: runtime needs a tiny compatibility shim — will add in PR. Might delay 30–45m.

Raj P: Heads up — SDKs have pinned dependency to runtime v0.13 in package.json. I'll update and run smoke tests.

Sam K: Ping me for reviews if you need faster merge. I'll be on call until 18:00 PT. :thumbsup: 

Olivia (eng-releases): Canary window scheduled Wed 09:00–12:00 PT. If anything blocks, flag here by Tue 12:00 PT so we can postpone.

Maria L: Marking blocker if shim isn't merged by 11:30. Will post status.

Raj P: I'll update release notes draft this evening.

Sam K: Ack. I'll squash and prep changelog entry.

Olivia (eng-releases): Thanks — assigning final cutover lead to @Sam K. I'll do the release tags and final smoke.

Sam K: Got it. :rocket:
